verdict.rationale: xAI docs show an extremely broad, well-documented API surface mirroring UI capabilities: text/chat, tool calling, web/code/MCP/collections tools, structured outputs, multi-agent research, image generation/editing, video generation/editing, TTS/STT/voice cloning, file/document search, and even a Management API and OpenAPI spec, indicating near-complete API/UI parity for an AI-native builder. Missing for 10: explicit first-party statement of 1:1 UI/API parity or independent hands-on confirmation that no UI-only features exist (e.g., memory/personalization), and community evidence focuses on model quality rather than API completeness.
